exposure: Self-administration of abortion drugs without medical consultation or supervision
outcome: Surgical intervention (D&E, laparotomy, suction and evacuation)
cohort: The study included 200 patients attending outpatient and emergency departments after unsupervised intake of abortion pills for medical termination of pregnancy.
finding: The primary finding was that 85% of women who self-administered abortion pills experienced incomplete abortion, and all patients required surgical intervention for definitive treatment.
gest_age: 55% consumed MTP pills between 7-9 weeks of gestation
